walkthrough.text: Child instrument stores guardian_wallet_id, undertaking evidence, relationship type, minor band, funding constraint. Uniqueness: one active minor instrument per child identity with this EMI; guardian may link more than one child.

J16.label: J16 · Par value · BV for cash
J16.plain: WALLET_CLOSED. Balance redeemed at par to a verified destination. CNIC-release policy applied. Records retained 10 years after relationship end. EMI §15 requires issuance and redemption at par, with no charges on redemption, and NADRA BV when e-money is redeemed in cash. Customer-requested closure, unverified-instrument closure (EMI 12.IV), and TFS/exit are different reasons that must not share one “delete account” b
J16.when: WALLET_ACTIVE, DEBIT_BLOCKED never verified, or MONITORING_HOLD confirmed TFS / offboarding.
J16.outcome: WALLET_CLOSED. Balance redeemed at par to a verified destination. CNIC-release policy applied. Records retained 10 years after relationship end.
J16.tip: Cooling period before the same CNIC may return; IBFT-only vs cash redemption in first slice — NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

forks.if: Not the same as live cash (J19)
forks.then: Not the same as live cash (J19)

walkthrough.title: Enters at
walkthrough.text: WALLET_ACTIVE, DEBIT_BLOCKED never verified, or MONITORING_HOLD confirmed TFS / offboarding.

walkthrough.title: Customer
walkthrough.text: Requests closure, or is told the instrument is being closed (unverified / TFS wording that does not tip off). For cash redemption: completes NADRA BV. For IBFT redemption: destination account is their own, with 2FA.

walkthrough.title: Operations
walkthrough.text: Three closure reasons, three files: (a) customer request, (b) never-verified + consider STR, (c) TFS/exit. Do not mix customer-facing text. Cash-out of remaining e-money: BV, or 2FA at ATM as EMI 14.II.d. Agent cash-out: BV or 2FA where BVS is a genuine constraint.

walkthrough.title: System
walkthrough.text: CLOSED is terminal. A later application is a new tracking ID and a new uniqueness check. Redemption payment is an auditable disbursement at par, linked to BV/2FA evidence.

J17.label: J17 · Refresh identity data
J17.plain: CDD_CURRENT after new evidence + re-screen, or RESTRICTED / J16 close if the customer will not refresh, or J10 if screening now hits. AML ongoing CDD is not the same as J10’s sanctions/TMS hit. NADRA particulars change (name after marriage, address), CNIC expiry, and timed CCOF obligations (expired ID + NADRA token: lodge the renewed copy within 3 months) all require a refresh case. Until it completes, services may b
J17.when: WALLET_ACTIVE. Triggers: CNIC expiry approaching; NADRA data change; periodic review due; CCOF 3-month renewed-ID clock.
J17.outcome: CDD_CURRENT after new evidence + re-screen, or RESTRICTED / J16 close if the customer will not refresh, or J10 if screening now hits.
J17.tip: Review cycle by risk band; whether liveness is required on every CNIC renew; restriction set while OVERDUE.

walkthrough.title: Enters at
walkthrough.text: WALLET_ACTIVE. Triggers: CNIC expiry approaching; NADRA data change; periodic review due; CCOF 3-month renewed-ID clock.

walkthrough.title: Customer
walkthrough.text: Is notified in-app + SMS/email that identity documents must be updated, with a tracking ID for the refresh case. Captures a live image of the renewed CNIC (and live photo if policy requires a fresh liveness).

walkthrough.title: Operations
walkthrough.text: Discrepancy notice inside a defined SLA. Do not restrict without having notified. Re-screen on the new particulars (screening moment 3). A new hit is J10, not “we’ll ignore because they were clear in 2026.”

walkthrough.title: System
walkthrough.text: CDD_REFRESH_DUE / IN_PROGRESS / CURRENT / OVERDUE are states payments can read. New CNIC image and NADRA result are new evidence objects; old ones stay in the audit trail.

J18.label: J18 · Digital IDs other than CNIC
J18.plain: Wallet at the verification-strength band after the same gates as J1–J4, with residency/ID type stored — or J8 if the ID class cannot be onboarded digitally. CCOF C.5 allows digital onboarding only for CNIC, NICOP, POC, POR or ARC holders. EMI 12.I also lists passport, but a passport-only customer is not on the digital path — they go J4/face-to-face. Non-resident Pakistanis and POC holders outside Pakistan may use Ver
J18.when: Spine at national-data capture when ID type is not a resident CNIC.
J18.outcome: Wallet at the verification-strength band after the same gates as J1–J4, with residency/ID type stored — or J8 if the ID class cannot be onboarded digitally.
J18.tip: When NADRA BV is operational for NRP/POC abroad; NICOP and CNIC as one person for EMI 12.VII — NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

walkthrough.title: Enters at
walkthrough.text: Spine at national-data capture when ID type is not a resident CNIC.

walkthrough.title: Customer
walkthrough.text: Selects ID type. Is not offered a digital path for passport-only or undocumented status. Provides the extra residency evidence the ID class needs (e.g. POC particulars, ARC/POR for Afghan refugees, overseas status).

walkthrough.title: Operations
walkthrough.text: Do not invent extra Pakistan digital ID types. CCOF C.5 is a closed list. Passport appears on EMI 12.I but not on CCOF digital-onboarding eligibility — treat passport-only as non-digital (J4).

walkthrough.title: System
walkthrough.text: id_class is a first-class field (CNIC / NICOP / POC / ARC / POR). Validation, NADRA product, and BV availability branch on it. NRP_BV_NOT_OPERATIONAL is a dated configuration flag, not a customer skip code.

J19.label: J19 · BV at the till · 2FA at ATM
J19.plain: CASH_POSTED at par after BV (cash-in) or 2FA/BV (cash-out) — or declined. Wallet stays WALLET_ACTIVE. A mule / structuring pattern is J10, not a successful till event. EMI 15.II lets a live wallet be funded by IBFT or by cash-in at EMI branches, agents, ATMs or bank branches — cash-in is subject to NADRA biometric verification. EMI 14.II.d requires 2FA for ATM cash-out and BV (or 2FA where BVS is a genuine constraint
J19.when: WALLET_ACTIVE customer presents at an agent, ATM, EMI branch or bank branch to load or withdraw cash.
J19.outcome: CASH_POSTED at par after BV (cash-in) or 2FA/BV (cash-out) — or declined. Wallet stays WALLET_ACTIVE. A mule / structuring pattern is J10, not a successful till event.
J19.tip: Which cash-in channels ship in the first slice (agent vs ATM vs bank branch); BVS-constraint policy for agent 2FA fallback — NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

forks.then: Verisys + till BV → also J13 upgrade

walkthrough.title: Enters at
walkthrough.text: WALLET_ACTIVE customer presents at an agent, ATM, EMI branch or bank branch to load or withdraw cash.

walkthrough.title: Customer
walkthrough.text: IBFT from their own bank account credits the wallet without this journey. For cash-in: presents at an EMI branch, agent, ATM or bank branch and completes NADRA BV. E-money is issued at par only after BV succeeds.

walkthrough.title: Operations
walkthrough.text: Do not fold this into J16. J16 redeems the remaining balance on close. J19 is cash in or out while the wallet is live. Agents distribute and redeem e-money; they never issue the instrument (EMI 17.VII). No “open wallet at the till.”

walkthrough.title: System
walkthrough.text: CASH_CASE stores channel (agent / ATM / EMI branch / bank), direction (in/out), amount, BV or 2FA evidence, and par-value posting. Credit the wallet only after BV_PASSED on cash-in (EMI 15.I–II). Debit cash-out only after 14.II.d is satisfied and HOLD/DEBIT_BLOCKED are clear.
